{{Quote|Can you help me recover some supplies we lost in the lower levels?|Captain Loman Vosso, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMS" />}}
'''Loman Vosso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:FtMS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she tasked a spacer to recover missing supplies lost in the [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels#Lower Maintenance Areas|lower maintenance areas]] of Coronet's [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels|maintenance tunnels]]. The spacer therefore descended into the hostile lower maintenance areas and fought a way through [[S-1 security droid|S-1]] and [[S-2 security droid]]s. The spacer managed to find all the supplies and successfully brought them back to Loman Vosso.<ref name="SWG:FtMS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loman Vosso appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Loman Vosso was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
